_about: Litter is left when a drink stand, snack bar, restroom, vending machine or bar serves someone. per_sale is added to each tile of the 3 by 3 around that stand. sources names those objects, the same names as the build menu. A litter bin within bin_radius metres cuts that new litter to bin_cut of per_sale. It does not pick up what is already on the grass; a porter does. Golfers complain once a tile reaches show, including when they are served at a stand that has already reached it. mood is the satisfaction change. patch is how many tiles out from the messy spot a porter clears, taking clean off each tile (1 clears a 3 by 3). score_floor is the worst job a porter will walk to, score_reach is how fast distance counts against a job, and window is how a broken window scores against litter.
